top_signals.title: RBA’s Bullock Says Economy Cooling, Unsure If Rates High Enough
top_signals.summary: Australia’s central bank chief said there are signs the economy is adjusting as anticipated, though it’s still unclear if this year’s interest-rate hikes are enough to return inflation to target or whether additional tightening will be needed.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: USD/PHP: Philippines Intervened in Small Way to Defend Peso, BSP Governor Says
top_signals.summary: The Philippine central bank intervened in a small way to defend the peso last week, Governor Eli Remolona said, as the currency weakened to a record low.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Malaysia detains over 100 Rohingya refugees seeking shelter at UNHCR
top_signals.summary: The refugees said they were driven out of their homes by local residents in the northern state of Penang and had traveled to Kuala Lumpur to seek assistance from the U.N. agency.

top_signals.summary: The surveillance system alerts first responders if someone lingers in certain locations, enters an area deemed unsafe or picks up a dedicated suicide-prevention phone.
